title: A Room for the House
author: Coral Ishikawa
blurb: Mirabel Fairweather, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. But when the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must finish the ritual the founders started, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
